select r.id as reservationId, d.name as doctorName, d.phone as doctorPhone, d.email as doctorEmail, dep.name as doctorDepartmentName, d.description as doctorDescription, r.create_time, r.status from reservation r left join doctor d on r.doctor_id = d.id left join department dep on d.department_id = dep.id where r.user_id = #{userId}

select r.id as reservationId, u.name as username, u.phone as userPhone, u.email as userEmail, u.sex, u.age, r.create_time, r.status from reservation r left join user u on r.user_id = u.id where r.doctor_id = #{doctorId}
